Some of the request and response fields are chain specific as described below. The fields can be computed with the help of a balance decreasing summary. ### UTXO (Bitcoin and Dogecoin) - `sourceAddressIndicator` is the the index of the transaction input in hex padded to a 0x prefixed 32-byte string. If the indicated input does not exist or the indicated input does not have the address, the attestation request is rejected. The `sourceAddress` is the address of the indicated transaction input. - `spentAmount` is the sum of values of all inputs with sourceAddress minus the sum of all outputs with `sourceAddress`. Can be negative. - `blockTimestamp` is the mediantime of a block. ### XRPL - `sourceAddressIndicator` is the standard address hash of the address whose balance has been decreased. If the address indicated by `sourceAddressIndicator` is not among the signers of the transaction and the balance of the address was not lowered in the transaction, the attestation request is rejected. - `spentAmount` is the difference between the balance of the indicated address after and before the transaction.
